nom: MAC Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil Face Wash

avis.texte: I love this. It works really well AND smells incredible. Would def recommend.

avis.titre: Fresh, gentle, and melts makeup instan
avis.texte: I absolutely love how lightweight and fresh this cleansing oil feels on my skin. It melts away makeup, sunscreen, and daily buildup so easily without leaving any greasy residue. My skin feels incredibly soft, clean, and hydrated after every use. I also have sensitive skin and eyes, and this works beautifully without irritation. It leaves my face looking fresh, smooth, and glowing. Definitely a new favorite in my cleansing routine.
Totally changed my night routine for the better! Rub oil over face then wipe or wash off and make up is GONE! AMAZING!!!

This is by far the best oil cleanser I've ever used! I started using this about 15 years ago when I saw the light and realized makeup wipes are horrible for your skin. I've strayed a few times and tried other oil cleansers over the years, but ALWAYS come back to this one. This is lightweight, emulsifies beautifully, then rinses off clean. I use it to pre-cleanse on days when I don't wear makeup (I don't use quite as much) because it keeps my skin soft and clean.

I have sensitive, oily, acne prone skin and this takes all my makeup off without any irritation. I love that it gently but effectively melts off all my makeup without leaving an oily film on my skin. Highly recommend.

I have been using this product for 8 months. I loved the former version of this product which was more effective at removing makeup. This leaves a film on your lashes even after multiple rinses and following with a foaming cleanser after. The film transfers to my eyeballs overnight. I wake up with blurry vision. It only goes away after showering the next morning.
Removes waterproof mascara easily. You do not need as much as you think you do. It doesn't irritate my eyes, skin, or ezcema. It doesn't break me out. A win all around.
This product removes stubborn makeup especially mascara. You just need a small drop. Your face feels very smooth afterwards. I recommend if you have makeup that is difficult to get off.
I've used Mac for years and throughout all my ageing it been the best.

avis.titre: Excellent Make-Up Remover - Great for skin!
avis.texte: I received this as a sample with a previous order. Have been searching forever for the perfect make-up remover. This cleanser works great as both a remover and a skin care, removing everything and leaving my skin silky smooth without no drying. No eyes burning either. Excellent product and I cannot recommend it enough!

I love the Hyper Real Cleansing Oil. It is a one stop for removing and cleansing my eye and face make up. It does leave my face feeling oily or dry. I recommend it to anyone who wears heavy make up and those who want to eliminate having to use eye make remover and a separate face cleanser.

Honestly I've been using this product for 2 almost three years. Works great, smells great, isn't super thick and only really need one pump. I recently tried to use another brand bc it was cheaper and returned it and just got this one. It's the best

avis.titre: Great and soft way to remove makeup
avis.texte: Fresh canvas is a great way to softly and completely remove makeup -- especially eye makeup and mascara. I originally got it as a free sample and when it was finished purchased it. I'll be a regular buyer as it does EXACTLY what it says.
This cleansing oil makes my skin so fresh and clean. No sticky residue. I definitely recommend it to my friends.

I bought this to replace my normal DHC deep cleansing oil (which I love). This lightweight oil really takes your makeup off including mascara. I always use a makeup remover wipe first, the cleansing oil, then a face wash. It works beautifully and I highly recommend.

Adding an oil cleanser has been game changing to my skin. I've had dry skin and large pores for as long as I can remember and adding this product into my evening routine has made the biggest impact. My pores are noticeably smaller and my makeup application is flawless.
I got this as a sample and wanted to try the full size, I have been using it & loving it! Gets my makeup off, but doesn't give that oily greasy feeling
Removes makeup with ease, no tugging at my eyes to remove waterproof mascara. A little goes a long way too. I've been using this product for a week and already know I will purchase again when needed.

I use this immediately after using the Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cream-To-Foam Cleanser I applied in shower before leather in my body like a moisturizing face mask and then I rinse it off while washing off the rest of my body and I've been getting super amazing results my skin looks soft and supple with the exact amount of moisture it needs to function. And to think I got it as a sample and fell in love with it now it's a part of my everyday skincare routine.
This product is perfect--leaves my skin feeling super clean and gets off all tough residue. No oily feel after using, does all the cleaning it needs to in one use.
Made in Japan and it's a good cleansing oil! Takes off my makeup and doesn't sting my eyes

What an amazing cleanser. Silky, cushioned oil on the skin. You can feel it working to get into every crevice of your skin. Then washes away like a milky dream. Expensive but worth it. And u feel like this will last a long time. Leaves skin squeaky clean without the tightness.

avis.titre: One of my favorite oil cleansers
avis.texte: This is my favorite makeup remover/ cleansing oil of all time. I would have bottles and bottles of this stuff if it was cheaper. For the price I wish it lasted me a little longer, but I'll sometimes redo my makeup 2 times a day as I am a content creator. I feel like this really helped me with skin texture and effortlessly removed makeup. It left my skin so smooth and hydrated.
Makes washing my face after wearing makeup all day so much easier! Also the oil smell nice too

Takes off any and all makeup, including pro-fomulas and waterproof formulas. Although, it is an oil, this product rinses off quickly and doesn't leave a greasy residue. It is also gentle enough to use on eyes without burning or irritation. 100% recommend.
This cleansing oil softened and evened out my pores my skin felt so smooth and clean. My makeup came off soo easily love this product will be buying again!

I'm so glad I took a chance. I got mine today. I love it so smooth and hydrating. This makes my 3rd purchase. I'm a new customer. I found this website on Instagram. I have the face moisturizer and the serum . I love all 3 of them
A very pleasant oil. It smells good, cleanses the skin perfectly, including from sunscreens. But it is not economical to use. The miniature received as a gift ended very quickly.
I'm not a fan of this product. Over priced for what you get. I was told it will take off eye makeup. It did, however, it left an oily film in my eyes. I do not recommend using this product.
I loooveeeee the texture. It is non-stimulating, but very effective at the same time!!! It cleans off all my makeup, including my foundation and the lipsticks!!

I love the texture of my skin after I use this product. It goes on smooth and silky and just a few drops are needed to take off most of my make-up. I do quite a bit of mascara so I never expected it to to take it all off in one pass, but it totally will if you use enough! It rinses clean and not greasy at all leaving zero residue. If I feel like my morning skin needs to be perked up, I just splash on a little and instant refreshment is mine!
Love this product after using one of the Mac Make up wipes! Not as greasy as you think! Leaving face feeling clean and smooth! Recommend!
Great size for the price. Works better than others I have tried.

I love the combination of the Cleansing oil followed by cream to lotion. The two together could be considered 'pricey' for the average person. I do love the soft glow to my skin and that's priceless. It's worth the extra few hours of work it takes to afford them on a regular basis.

Have always used coconut oils to remove my makeup and recently decided to try the Hyper Real oil after using the serumizer. OMG! Super lightweight and actually has ability to rinse off. Removes makeup, doesn't cause breakouts, doesn't leave skin greasy, and leaves a softness. Pairs exceptionally well with the cream cleanser for a soft and beautiful look. In a week of using I've had 2 unknown people tell me I had great skin. Thank you MAC for helping me age gracefully!!

I purchased this product as a replacement to the older "cleanse off oil" sinces thats been discontinued. I do not like the scent of this procust. Its a atrong floral and its boraderline headache inducing.

avis.titre: Irritated skin. Fragrance is too strong
avis.texte: For anyone who has sensitive/reactive skin or uses a retinoid, BEWARE. The fragrance in this new cleansing oil is strong. It made face red + lightly itchy every time I used it. I haven't had a reaction like this to a skincare product in years. The old cleansing oil was perfection. Please bring it back!

I purchased this because I wanted a make up remover. I was surprised at how amazing this feels on the skin! I was worried it would be too oily but it does not leave skin oily. It leaves the skin sooooo velvety and soft! Leaves skin feeling so clean and smooth. I do have to apply it twice on eyes to get mascara all the way off but it's a great product. The big bottle has lasted me a long time as well! Worth the money spent!
This is by far my favorite cleanser, I am left with clean, smooth, hydrated skin. Literally no other cleansing oil compares.

I absolutely love all 3 products. The seru,izer alone is great. While the balm too alone is perfection. With the cleansing oil my face has never felt this good .I cannot say enough. You have to buy these products. Be no regrets.

A good cleansing oil but not an amazing one, I've used better! It smells nice and the bottle is pretty but I feel like I have to use wash my face a couple times to get the makeup off. I do like it though!

When they got rid of the original cleanse of oil, I was heartbroken. I'm glad to say I like this one even more than the original! MAC is the only company that can make an oil cleanser that leaves NO residue—and I've tried so many others. For those that claim their skin is dry after using this, I'm not sure how that's possible. Maybe try pairing this with the rest of the skincare line, which is also excellent.
It's not bad, but it can't compete to Demalogica one. I would say this one is second best!

I have really been surprised by the rest of the Hyper Real line and my oily skin has loved it, so I tried the Cleansing Oil and I like it a lot! It's really lightweight and thin for an oil, it feels almost watery. Very effective at removing makeup and cleansing skin gently. Will be repurchasing, even if it was the most expensive cleansing oil I've purchased.

avis.titre: Hyper Real Fresh Canvas cleansing oil
avis.texte: I bought this cleansing oil awhile ago when it first dropped and i absolutely love it! It makes my skin feel so smooth and i use this as my double cleanse step in my routine. Its very lightweight, silky, and the price is reasonable for this much product.

When I received the product the bottle was opened and it was half empty but when I used it it really feel good on my skin. Packaging is not at all good for which I will give a bad rating but the oil is definitely something and I loved it.

avis.titre: HYPER REAL FRESH CANVAS CLEANSING OIL
avis.texte: I received this product as a free sample with my last order. First of all, let me start out by saying I have used so many products to remove my make-up and nothing has come close. This is the only product that has been able to remove all my make-up. I will be purchasing a full size product now.
Skeptical on product but once I tried it it was leaving my skin smooth. Love this product mac has done it again truly satisfied with my purchase
Lightweight great formula. I use it as a moisturizer sometimes.

I was excited to try this because I love oil cleansing in place of makeup remover wipes. I used this a few times and each time it unfortunately left my skin dry and flaky - but it definitely removed my makeup. The packaging is nice though

I bought this product to help with removing stubborn eye makeup. The oil spurts out of the dispenser awkwardly so much of it is wasted. It removes the unwanted makeup but I have blurred vision and all day eye irritation after use. I don't know what ingredient is causing it.
I have tried using olive oil and I was sensitive to it in my skin. This stuff works great for my oily skin. It breaks down my makeup with ease.
This is the best cleanser I have ever used! It is very lightweight but extremely effective. My skin has a glow to it now that I haven't seen since I was in my teens!
I really like this product because it begins as an oil to break down any make up then turns into a wash once you add water! Very moisturizing and doesn't strip your face?
This is a good cleansing oil that removes make up well. It does not break me out which is a plus!

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: I am in love with this cleansing oil! My skin feels amazing after using, no exaggeration. My skin feels super soft and refreshed. A little bit goes a long way and it didn't irritate my skin. Plus, it isn't greasy or drying.
The oil was very cleansing and melted my leftover make up right off. It does need to be followed with a cleanser otherwise it feels like there's still residue.
After I used this makeup removal my vision was blurry for More than one minute
After I used this makeup removal my vision was blurry for More than one minute
The brand that keeps on giving! I'm so happy this is now a part of my skin care routine. Lightweight, good texture, pleasant smell and overall great investment.

This cleansing oil is lovely and luxurious. It comes with a pump to help prevent creating a mess. The formula itself does a great job of removing all the makeup I wear. It also leaves my face feeling extra smooth.

This is a must have for anyone who wears makeup. This is such a gentle way to remove even heavy makeup, I am absolutely amazed. You will not need a huge amount of product to remove heavy makeup. Even removes waterproof makeup. Absolutely love it!
I did actually enjoy using this product. I felt that it did remove all my makeup with stripping my skin. It felt nice and milky on the skin and was easy to rinse off.

These Mac products are great. The cleansing oil has a bit of an odd perfume-y smell to it but it's not off putting. I like to wash my face with it in the shower. They put a great amount of thought into this by including both a pump and a top! The hydrating cream does not have a scent. The serum is light and very refreshing!
I usually don't gravitate towards cleansing oils as I have oil to combo skin and they usually leave a film on me but this one didn't give me that feeling after taking off my makeup

This has got to be the best cleanser I've ever used! It instantly melts of all my makeup without stripping it of its moisture. I've used many cleaners but nothing compares to how quick and easy this cleanser removes my most layered makeup looks.
Soft, lightweight cleansing oil, left my skin completely nongreasy but glowing.
Good light face wash, just don't really love the scent of it. But feels nice on your skin and cleanses well.

I've never used a cleansing oil before, I've always used makeup wipes or more recently makeup removing balms. As excited as I was, I was also a little hesitant because I didn't want this cleansing oil to leave me a big oily mess. It was thin which didn't turn out to be a bad thing because a little went a long way which means this product should last. That little bit of product was able to melt away my makeup with ease and didn't leave any residue around my eyes like some of my other makeup removers do. It left my skin feeling clean and refreshed without feeling greasy and like there was a layer over it which was my main concern. It also didn't feel very drying, so I believe the moisturizing effect is there. Overall I'm impressed with this product and happy I can rely on the MAC name to give me something I know will do the job right with quality ingredients.
This was my first time using a cleansing oil and I can say that this did a good job at melting away all my makeup and leaving my skin very moisturized. I would highly recommend.

avis.titre: Very useful for make up wearers
avis.texte: This cleansing oil is very soft but leaves your skin with a nice finish and also removes all of your make up! I enjoyed how it did not irritate my skin.
I like you using this cleansing oil. To remove my make up that is waterproof. It takes it off really smooth and easy. It's not really hard for my skin. It also leavs my skin glowing.
This product melts away makeup and also does wonders at removing eyelash adhesive. Very easy and sensitive on the skin and leaves you with a fresh canvas.

This removes makeup really well. I have used cleansing balms, wipes and micellar water but this removes makeup like magic. Leaves skin feeling hydrated and clean. On lazy days I go to sleep without moisturising my face when use this to remove makeup. Highly recommend.
Absolutely loved this cleansing oil doesnt leave an oily residue and is really gentle! It also still does a good job of removing all my makeup.
This product is one of my favorite cleansers. It is gentle on the skin, has a light scent (not noticeable), and has a slightly thicker consistency. It left my skin feeling very clean!

The Mac Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil was a great product to help clean my face. It removed makeup and dirt without making my skin feel oily. The oil has good ingredients like jojoba and sunflower seed oils that help keep my skin moisturized. I like that it works really well on tough makeup like waterproof mascara.

I've been using this to remove my makeup for the last couple weeks, and it makes it so easy to remove stubborn makeup! I usually do several layers of makeup since I have acne and acne scars, and this makes the removal process so much easier! Way better than the wipes or any other brands I've used.
Removed all of my makeup easily! Love the packaging, plus for the pump.
I am so deeply upset that they discontinued the MAC cleanse off oil which I used for over a decade and replaced it with this overpriced product. I have switched to another brand now.
It has a very nice smell and light to the touch! It does a great job removing makeup
I think this product overall wasn't the best for my skin type, but the quality of the packaging and cleansing oil were nice.

avis.titre: Best cleansing oil I have ever tried!
avis.texte: This cleansing oil is packed with benefits and works amazing! No other cleansing oil can compare. My favorite thing about this is it is so gentle on your skin and I accidently got some in my eye and it was like nothing got it my eye! The texture is amazing and the warming sensation as you are running your makeup off is a nice touch. It gets all the makeup and impurities out of your skin while moisturizing and keeping your skin healthy. I could not recommend this product enough!
I love this cleanser. oil based , gets all the make up off !! i would recommend this product. little goes a long way
Loved this cleanser so much. I was syllable to remove all my makeup with just one pump. Smells great too

I am obsessed with this cleansing oil. It strips off all of my daily makeup looks with ease while also cleansing and hydrating my skin at the same time. I love how it doesn't leave my face feeling oily but very lightweight. My skin have been glowing ever since I started using this cleanser. I love it.

This oil is so great at taking makeup off in the PM as a pre-cleanse. This could be used on its own if you don't have makeup on, but I usually cleanse with soap after using this. Overall it leaves my skin feeling super clean and soft.
This stuff took my makeup off in literally like 5 seconds. It was so crazy to me!! I absolutely love it!

Probably my most favorite cleansing oil I have ever used, it is so light and melts makeup so easily, it cleaned my mascara like a dream. It is a blessing for my dry my skin, so gentle yet effective. I also love the packaging it's such a luxury feel.
This was my first cleansing oil, I highly recommended it ! My skin felt so smooth and soft and a little goes a long way! Highly recommend!!
Ok first I'm so happy this isn't a strong scent. But I love an oil cleanser vs a balm. It really gets off all that tough makeup and sunscreen I apply on a daily basis!

I have to say I'm thrilled with the result. My pores look smaller and overall my skin is much smoother making makeup application breasy. I've actually experienced less oil production throughout the day. My foundation looks even and fresh for hours, with no need to blot. The product smells great, and leaves skin feeling smooth, soft, and clean. Love it!

I love how easily it removes all impurities from my bare skin and also all types of makeup product. I used it to remove artistic makeup look, easy to remove leaving my skin soft. No irritation and no dryness.
I really like this product! It takes off makeup with a breezy! I use this with my reusable cotton pad and it works like a charm!
I loved how nicely this took off my makeup and cleared all the dust,makeup and dirt off my face without stripping my skin. In addition,the light scent was amazing!

This is a great cleansing oil that isn't messy. I like that this easily slips onto my skin and gently breaks down my makeup and sunscreen. It didn't irritate my skin or cause any breakouts. It's a great first step to a second cleanse. There was no nasty residue or greasy feel left behind.

I love this cleansing oil. To start off, I loved the packaging, but that's the least. Right away I was excited because the bottle is pretty big, for sure it'll last long. I had a full face off make up and took two pumps of the cleansing oil. Applied all over my face. I add water and rub in circular motions. It melted my make up off immediately. The skin is left feeling so soft!

MAC Cosmetics Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil is an excellent choice for anyone who wants to achieve a clean and fresh canvas before applying makeup. This oil effectively removes makeup, dirt, and impurities from the skin without leaving any residue behind. Its lightweight formula contains a blend of natural oils and antioxidants that help to nourish and protect the skin, leaving it feeling soft and hydrated. What I love about this cleansing oil is how gentle it is on the skin. It doesn't cause any irritation or breakouts, and it doesn't strip the skin of its natural oils. Instead, it leaves the skin feeling refreshed and ready for makeup application. The packaging is also a plus, as it comes with a pump that makes it easy to dispense the right amount of product. Overall, I highly recommend MAC Cosmetics Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil to anyone who wants to achieve a clean and fresh canvas before applying makeup, or to anyone who wants a gentle and effective cleansing oil for everyday use.
I love this fresh canvas cleansing oil. It works great on removing make up and dirt. It's easy to use will be switching to this as my go to make up remover

I have dry, dehydrated skin. I always wear sunscreen and normally wear a light CC cream and some blush. This cleansing oil doesn't dry out my skin and is able to remove all my face makeup. I find it a bit hard to remove my waterproof mascara unless I rub my eyes really hard. Overall, I'm impressed how it doesn't leave oily residue while still hydrated and able to remove all my face makeup.
It has a light pleasant scent from the botanicals. Leaves skin feeling very clean but not uncomfortable. Removed waterproof eyeliner and emulsifies well.

I only recently starting double cleansing on days when I wore makeup. This is a perfect first step product to remove makeup. I do tend to prefer oil free products especially since I have eyelash extensions and it removes them, however if you like cleansing oils this is a great choice. The product comes in a large bottle that will last a very long time and I do feel like it lives up to it's claims.

This cleaning oil is so light weight and helps removes your make very well. I only used the cleaning oil to remove my makeup and I am impressed. I didn't need to use anything else to remove my makeup and my skin felt clean after.

Ob-sessedddd I am not lying when I say this but the amount of girls who noticed my skin has been glowing is wow! This product is so so gentle on skin. Yes, it's oil but once you wash the product off it'll leave your skin super soft and a soft natural glow. I have been doing the 3 step process which includes serum and moisturizer and wow! My skin has not looked without makeup. 100% recommend
This cleansing oil is amazing and gets off all the makeup and dirt you can't see
I HIGHLY recommend adding this to your cleansing routine! I like to double cleanse with an oil cleanser and a gel cleanser and this makes your face so clean and makes it look amazing!
I was very impressed with this cleanser and I loved that it came with the pump attachment. It felt moisturizing but at the same time I got that "took the day off" feeling.
I really enjoyed thiscleanser! It got all of the day off with just a small amount of product which was very impressive to me
I didn't care for it that much, didn't make my skin feel clean.

avis.titre: MAC HAS ENTERED THE SKINCARE GAME
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleansing oil! Its like a MAC makeup wipe in a bottle. It even removes my waterproof mascara. I highly recommend this if you are into double cleansing.

First and foremost, I was extremely impressed with how effectively this cleansing oil removed my makeup and any impurities from my skin. It's gentle yet powerful formula really gets the job done without leaving any residue or making my skin feel greasy. I love how lightweight and refreshing the formula feels on my skin. It's a pleasure to use and doesn't leave any sticky or heavy feeling behind. Instead, my skin feels incredibly soft and smooth after using this product. Another standout feature of this cleansing oil is its subtle but delightful scent. It's not overpowering at all, but it adds a pleasant touch to my cleansing routine that makes me look forward to using it every day. Overall, I highly recommend Mac Cosmetics Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil to anyone who is looking for a high-quality, effective, and enjoyable cleansing oil. It's definitely worth the investment, and I'm confident that it will become a staple in your skincare routine just as it has in mine!
I love how this cleansing leave my skin super clean and soft. I recommend it

I wish I could say I enjoy using this product unfortunately this was not the case. I am an almost everyday makeup wearer so I was looking forward to trying a new makeup removing cleanser. The makeup cleanser did a good job at removing all makeup but I experienced burning in my eyes and blurred vision for a few minutes until I was able to completely wash out my eyes. Thus was both a painful and scary experience I would not like to relocate. I will not be using the product again.
Love this product and it helps remove makeup, sunscreen, etc!

avis.titre: Great for getting makeup off but you could breakout
avis.texte: The oil was great to remove makeup but I feel like I had some breakout problems after.

It comes in a nice packaging and easy to use. It cleans very well and removes all the dirt and oil from face. Doesn't dry out skin and skin feels fresh and refreshing. It doesn't leave any residue behind. I will purchase it again.
Really easy to use. I love how blend off my makeup and doesn't feel oily.
